pages.text: The nydus network stands by a zerg base. From it a long winding tunnel of flesh, full of liquid creep, runs 64-112 blocks under the land.

At the far end a nydus worm comes out, guarded by a spine crawler. A wild base digs toward its nearest foe and sends warriors through every minute until six stand by the worm; when either end is attacked, help comes through.

Your own: a drone builds the network (a lair is needed) and then the worm where you want it; when the worm is done, the corridor is dug from the nearest network. Order your zerg to move onto the network or the worm: they come out at the other end.$(br2)In liquid creep zerg rush and heal; others are poisoned.
